notes: MedalCount.sas cleans a scraped Winter Olympics medal table (SASUSER.MEDALS, populated by TableScrape.py) and charts it. Bundle prepends a small mock SASUSER.MEDALS (same NOC/gold/total columns, plus a '*'-annotated NOC, an Individual Neutral row, and a Totals row) so the author's cleaning logic runs standalone. DATA-step SELECT/WHEN country->ISO2 mapping, TOTALS/Individual Neutral deletes, compress, PROC SORT, and PROC SGPLOT hbar all preserved verbatim. Dropped only the PROC SGMAP world-map block (needs mapsgfk.world map library). Deterministic across 2 POSTs.
